WildSpark 2.1.2 fixes square WildFire icons. The shared circular mask previously had an opaque alpha channel, so the game ignored its grayscale circle when masking item and spell icons. The alpha now carries the circular shape used by WildFire's round buttons.

## Install

Extract `WildSpark-2.1.2.zip` and copy the included `WildSpark` folder into `Interface/AddOns`.
